description: Remediation quality and template rules — standards for evaluating recommendation quality. Sourced from review_taxonomy.yaml (REC) and system_responsibility.md.

entries.title: Recommendation must address root cause, not just symptoms
entries.description: A quality remediation addresses the root cause of the vulnerability. Recommendations that only address symptoms (e.g., 'update to latest version' without explaining why) are flagged as weak. The recommendation should explain what to fix and why.
entries.action: Flag as weak/generic recommendation (taxonomy REC). Do NOT generate new recommendation text. Suggest human write specific remediation.

entries.title: Recommendation must be actionable
entries.description: A recommendation should provide concrete, implementable steps. Vague advice like 'implement security controls' or 'follow best practices' is not actionable. The reviewer should be able to understand what specific action to take.
entries.action: Flag as non-actionable recommendation (taxonomy REC). Reduce confidence score. Suggest human provide specific steps.

entries.title: Recommendation must be technically relevant to the vulnerability
entries.description: The recommendation must be technically relevant to the specific vulnerability described. A recommendation for a different vulnerability type or a generic security hardening step that doesn't address the reported issue is flagged.
conditions: recommendation does not match vulnerability type
entries.action: Flag as technically irrelevant recommendation (taxonomy REC). This reduces confidence in the overall finding quality.

entries.title: SLM must not generate new remediation text
entries.description: The SLM can evaluate whether a recommendation is adequate, but must not generate new remediation text. Writing remediation is a human-only responsibility in v1. The SLM flags weak recommendations and escalates for human writing.
entries.action: Flag as insufficient. Do NOT generate replacement text. Escalate to human reviewer to write specific remediation.

entries.title: Web application remediation should reference specific controls
entries.description: For web application findings, the recommendation should reference specific security controls (e.g., input validation, CSP headers, parameterized queries) rather than generic advice. OWASP recommendations are preferred references.
entries.action: Flag as generic web remediation. Suggest referencing specific OWASP controls. Do not auto-generate specific recommendations.

entries.title: Mobile application remediation should address platform-specific controls
entries.description: For mobile application findings (Android/iOS), the recommendation should address platform-specific security controls (e.g., Android Network Security Config, iOS App Transport Security) rather than generic web advice.
conditions: finding domain is android_application or ios_application
entries.action: Flag as potentially irrelevant mobile remediation. Suggest platform-specific controls. Do not auto-generate.
